k:艶.mnemonic: Beans (豆) glazed until their color (色) shines, so polished that the light seems to bend (曲) around each one. Glossy (luster, glaze, polish).

k:霜.mnemonic: Rain (雨) and the cold night air reach a mutual (相) agreement: instead of falling, the water settles on the grass as white crystals. Frost.

k:餓.mnemonic: An ego (我) too proud to eat (食) what is offered: he waves away the plain rice and waits for a banquet that never comes. Starve (hungry, thirst).

k:嗣.mnemonic: The old man's hat hangs on the same (同) hook (亅) and his walking stick (｜) leans by the same door, both waiting for the one who will take them up after him. Heir (succeed).

k:痩.mnemonic: Weeks in the sickbed (疒) with no appetite, and also (又) no dessert. When you finally get up, your belt needs a new hole. Get thin.

k:諦.mnemonic: Once the sovereign (帝) has had his say (言), the matter is plain and final. You see how things truly stand and stop arguing. Clarity (truth, abandon, give up).

k:勾.mnemonic: A cocoon (厶) tucked inside a cradle (勹): the grub within lies curled like a hook, its back curved to fit. Be bent (slope, capture).
k:勾.hint: A grub curled in its bed.

k:紺.mnemonic: Thread (糸) dipped again and again into a vat of sweet (甘) smelling indigo, until it comes out nearly black. Dark blue (navy).

k:閥.mnemonic: Behind the gate (門) sits a group who fell (伐) anyone trying to enter without the right family name. Only their own kind get in. Clique (lineage, pedigree, faction).

k:淑.mnemonic: Even as a tsunami (氵) rolls in, uncle (叔) strolls to high ground with perfect poise, not a hair out of place, bowing to the neighbours. Graceful (gentle, pure).

k:坑.mnemonic: Miners dig deep into the soil (土) and prop the roof with timbers shaped like a table (几), so that they can work underneath. Pit (hole).

k:妬.mnemonic: A woman (女) stares at the huge stone (石) on her friend's ring finger, and her smile goes stiff. Jealous (envy).

k:抹.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) press a cloth back and forth across the board until the last (末) trace of chalk is gone. Rub (paint, erase).

k:漬.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of brine fills the barrel, and the cucumbers sit in it for weeks. If they come out too sour, blame (責) the salt. Pickling (soak, moisten, steep).

k:燥.mnemonic: Wet goods (品) hang on a tree (木) beside a fire (火). The heat draws out every drop until they are stiff and crackling. Parch (dry up).

k:弄.mnemonic: A bored king (王) holds twenty (廾) jewels in his hands and idly rolls and fiddles with them all day, doing nothing useful. Play with (tamper, trifle with).
k:弄.hint: A bored ruler fiddling with jewels.

k:擦.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) drag a block of cheese across metal teeth. Pressing too hard? Too soft? You can only guess (察) from the scraping sound. Grate (rub, scratch, scrape).

k:錠.mnemonic: A gold (金) device on the door whose pins determine (定) who may come in: only the one right key will turn it. Lock (fetters, shackles).

k:雌.mnemonic: The turkey (隹) hen will stop (止) pecking to sit on her nest, turning each egg as gently as if with a spoon (匕). She is the mother bird. Feminine (female, woman, girl).

k:姻.mnemonic: The woman (女) is the cause (因) of the whole gathering: two families in their best clothes, a ring and a vow. Matrimony (marry).
k:姻.hint: Two families, a ring, a vow.

k:廉.mnemonic: Under a market canopy (广) a stall sells a good broom (ヨ) for next to nothing: honest goods at an honest price. Bargain (reason, charge, suspicion).

k:鬱.mnemonic: Deep among the cedar (杉) trees a man sits with his forehead (冖) in his hands, a tin can (缶) of bitter brew (鬯) beside him. No light gets through the branches. Gloom (depression, melancholy, luxuriant).
k:鬱.hint: Head in hands under dark trees.

k:滴.mnemonic: Three small beads of water slide down the left side of a tall covered tank, leaking out one after another. Drip (drop).

k:酵.mnemonic: Out of filial piety (孝) a son tends his father's wine jar (酉) every day, keeping it warm while the mash bubbles and slowly turns. Fermentation.

k:采.mnemonic: A claw (爪) reaches into a tree (木), plucks a hard nut and rolls it across the ground to see which side lands up. Dice (form, appearance, take).

k:侶.mnemonic: In all of history (史) no leader (亻) ever walked alone: someone was always a step behind, sharing the road and the campfire. Companion (follower).

k:濁.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) stirs a net (罒), an insect (虫) and a cradle (勹) into muddy water. Speak through that murk and a clear sound comes out thick and buzzing. Voiced (uncleanness, wrong, impurity).

k:餌.mnemonic: A stubborn (艮) mule will not move until you dangle something to eat (食) beside its ear (耳). Then it follows the treat anywhere. Food (bait, prey, tempting profit).
k:餌.hint: A treat dangled before a mule.

k:冶.mnemonic: Icicles (冫) set on a pedestal (台) over the furnace soften and run like liquid metal into the mould below. Melting (smelting).
